### Announced at the 2026 APLMS healthy longevity summit, MorePerfect.ai builds on the[Digital Super-Highway vision](https://www.einpresswire.com/article/947012041/aplms-and-vsee-to-build-asia-pacific-digital-health-infrastructure-for-healthy-longevity-and-active-aging) with a practical front door for longevity clinic discovery, precision data workflows and future “body twin” intelligence


VSee today announced **MorePerfect.ai** , a new healthy longevity initiative designed to help patients search and compare longevity clinics, diagnostics, programs and pricing—while giving clinics and researchers a path toward AI-ready data collaboration for functional longevity and healthy aging research.


Announced by **Dr. Milton Chen, PhD, CEO and co-founder of VSee** , during his talk at the[Asia-Pacific Longevity Medicine Society (APLMS) conference](https://www.apaclongevitysociety.org/#/meeting/index?id=OQ%3D%3D) , MorePerfect.ai is envisioned as both a patient-facing discovery platform and a future data intelligence layer for precision longevity medicine.


The announcement follows an earlier APLMS–VSee release introducing the[Asia-Pacific Healthy Longevity Digital Super-Highway](https://www.einpresswire.com/article/947012041/aplms-and-vsee-to-build-asia-pacific-digital-health-infrastructure-for-healthy-longevity-and-active-aging) , a proposed cross-border digital infrastructure for connecting longevity science, clinical expertise, trusted data, AI agents, digital health tools and care delivery across the region.


If the Digital Super-Highway is the road system, **MorePerfect.ai is one of the first on-ramps** —helping patients find trusted longevity resources today, while preparing clinics and researchers to connect data, workflows and insights tomorrow.


“Every longevity clinic is running its own small experiment, and most of what they learn stays inside their walls,” said **Dr. Milton Chen, PhD, CEO and co-founder of VSee** . “MorePerfect.ai lets clinics learn from patients like theirs anywhere in the region, on their own terms. A clinician in Singapore can see how a patient’s body twin in Seoul, Sydney, or San Francisco responded to a protocol, without either clinic giving up control of its data.”


## **A Practical Starting Point for Precision Longevity**


MorePerfect.ai currently provides a searchable directory of healthy longevity clinics, designed to help patients compare clinic services, diagnostics, programs and pricing with source-backed information.


Over time, VSee envisions MorePerfect.ai evolving into a trusted network for longevity clinics and researchers to identify similar patient profiles—or “body twins”—based on available clinical, genomic, biometric, laboratory, wearable, imaging, lifestyle and other health data types.


The goal is to support more precise, evidence-informed longevity care by helping clinicians and researchers better understand how similar individuals respond to different interventions, protocols and care models.


## **Built on VSee’s Modular Digital Health Platform**


MorePerfect.ai is supported by the **VSee platform** , an enterprise digital health infrastructure designed for rapid, customized deployment across complex healthcare and research environments.


VSee’s modular, “LEGO-like” architecture allows clinics, researchers and healthcare organizations to configure digital workflows around their specific needs—whether for virtual consultations, longevity intake, remote monitoring, patient-reported outcomes, diagnostics coordination, data capture, AI-assisted workflows or longitudinal research.


Rather than forcing every clinic into the same workflows, VSee enables organizations to connect the tools, data sources and functionalities they already use, and add new capabilities as their programs mature.


## **AI Where It Is Needed Most**


VSee’s AI integration module is designed to make it easier to insert AI at the point of care, in research workflows, or wherever intelligence is most useful.


For longevity medicine, this could include support for clinic discovery, patient matching, knowledge navigation, data analysis, remote monitoring, care coordination and future “body twin” comparisons—while keeping clinical decision-making under qualified professional oversight.


VSee is also exploring ambient and continuous monitoring concepts, including smart mattress and radar-based systems, to support passive health tracking, fall detection, mortality risk prediction and early identification of meaningful changes in health status. These concepts remain in development and are part of VSee’s broader healthy aging innovation roadmap.


## **Connecting Patients, Clinics and Researchers**


With MorePerfect.ai, VSee aims to address two near-term needs in longevity medicine:


- **For patients:** make it easier to find and compare verified longevity clinics, diagnostics, programs and pricing.
- **For clinics and researchers:** create a pathway to participate in AI-ready, data-driven longevity research without giving up control of their data or being forced into a rigid technology stack.


Patients can search and compare verified longevity clinics, diagnostics, programs and pricing at **moreperfect.ai** .


Longevity clinics and researchers interested in being listed in the directory or in setting up their complimentary **VSee EMR + Clinic** can contact us at[vsee.com](https://vsee.com/contactsales) or call 650-209-6337 ext. 1.
